Project: realtime microphone visualizer

- Use Vite + React + TypeScript conventions.
- Keep the UI live-performance friendly, dark, and modern.
- Prefer microphone input first; do not add DJ software integrations unless requested.
- Keep visual code modular: audio analysis, canvas rendering, and UI controls should stay separate.
- Preserve build stability and avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- When editing visuals, maintain a voxel / neon stage aesthetic.
- Update README and project notes when user-facing behavior changes.
